decisions.rationale: The coverage wrapper retains installed insert/alley support while its current subcontroller is ManCoverage. Activation requires current run belief and an affirmative personally acquired carrying picture of an originally backfield RB/FB. It passes the consumed cue into the existing keyed run fit, without live-possession confirmation. Both prerequisites are reevaluated every tick; supportRecorded affects diagnostics only. Recognized flight yields to the unchanged ball priority. Force/cutback and originally split backs are excluded.

Held and unrecognized-flight states preserve that movement instruction. If support evidence is absent, ordinary installed man technique continues through unrecognized flight via #75. Existing recognized-flight priority wins over stale positive back pictures in both layers.

These tests will exercise the composed source in Integration's one exact combined verification. No separate replay, scenario, suite repeat or extra test is requested by this review.
